context: Write docs/adr/0004-hosted-credential-lifecycle.md and docs/operations/hosted-credentials.md. Decide and justify TTLs from an owner/rotation matrix rather than Turso's implicit never expiration. Specify planned overlap replacement versus compromise response: database-level invalidate first, then mint and redistribute all DB-scoped credentials with coordinated interruption. Prohibit automatic minting and non-expiring production RW tokens; permit any no-exp RO exception only with named risk acceptance. Record a go/no-go decision for advisory exp diagnostics plus sanitized-fixture, unverified-claims and opaque-token requirements; implementation belongs only in the dependent hosted-auth-expiry-diagnostics item. Update documentation examples with explicit --expiration and capability. Cross-link ADR 0003 rather than duplicating its actor threat model.
description: Binding policy and documentation deliverable for hosted Turso credentials. Separate data-plane DB access from control-plane provisioning; choose explicit bounded RO/RW token profiles, external secret injection, routine replacement and database-wide compromise response; remove normal-runtime dependence on Turso CLI auth. Record that read-only is server-enforced only when TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN is genuinely RO, that database-scoped tokens are the supported model, and that group-scoped tokens require a separate invalidation runbook. Decide, but do not implement, whether advisory JWT-expiry diagnostics are justified. This item owns ADR, runbook, README and skill policy only; source, tests, workflow enforcement and secret storage are out of scope.

anti_patterns.dont: Persist tokens in a todo-db-managed 0600 cache
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD require an external keychain, password manager, CI secret, or environment injector
anti_patterns.why: permissions alone do not solve symlink, backup, ownership, rotation, or caller-environment problems

anti_patterns.dont: Use Turso's implicit never expiration in production examples
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD pass an explicit TTL selected by the policy matrix
anti_patterns.why: compromise has no natural bound and revocation rotates database signing keys globally

preserves.behavior: Hosted credentials remain externally injected; todo-db never writes bearer tokens to disk, config, logs, audit events, or TODO evidence.
Scheduled audit remains server-enforced read-only and CI never receives TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN.

verifications.command: test -z "$(rg -n 'turso (db|group) tokens create' README.md docs | grep -v -- '--expiration')"
verifications.description: Every documented token mint is explicitly bounded
